I'll loop in Priyom (solutions) to produce a short technical appendix and a capacity matrix. Can you confirm procurement contact and whether the term extension should be exactly 12 months from renewal date? Once we have that we'll produce a combined renewal + expansion quote and a draft SOW.

Subject: RE: Renewal + on-prem expansion: technical appendix & capacity options

Team —

Following up with the technical options for Aurora's ask. I pulled together a compact capacity matrix and a few deployment constraints. Included below are the recommended defaults and a note on the isolation approach.

Recommended config (baseline)
- Cluster: 8x GPUs, 1.5TB RAM aggregate, NVMe scratch per node
- Model runtime: quantized 8-bit profile recommended for cost/latency balance on inference
- Storage: NFS mount for shared artifacts + object-store proxy for backups

Isolation approaches (pros/cons)
- Tenant carve-out (software): quicker, shared hardware footprint, strong logical isolation, recommended if Aurora accepts software isolation controls
- Physical isolation (dedicated hardware): stronger assurance for PII, longer lead time and higher capex, recommended if Procurement requires air-gapped assurance

Network & cutover notes
- Need a scheduled maintenance window for firewall changes; expect 2–4 hours of connectivity reconfiguration for peering and NAT updates.
- If Aurora wants a staged cutover we can run shadow traffic for 2 weeks before final cutover.

Deliverables I can produce this week: capacity matrix (CSV), cutover runbook, and a short checklist for SOC2 artifacts.

Priyom
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
